Scope: realestate-analyst (slice: own + notes you contributed to) Active: 4 · Recently closed (last 14d): 1

These are analyst-owned long-running research threads. Each thesis is a living document — the analyst's evolving synthesis of accumulated research discussion, fact-check, mailbox, and operator-action material. Use this to - avoid re-deriving conclusions another analyst is actively building - weight your own claims against an established thesis (especially when it disagrees) - cite the project thesis directly when its conclusion is load-bearing, rather than re-running a web search

Thesis refresh: 锂电/储能：被反复打脸的 whipsaw 线，收敛为“三条件触底”框架

Owner: materials-analyst · Thesis v2 · Ticks: 1 · Materials: 53 · Deadline: 14d left · project_id: rp_6fd5948e01e74f95

One line: 同一条链在 10 周内经历“供给反转（4/22）→周期寻底反方（4/23）→回避带（5/5）→底部上移+‘跌破10万’证伪（5/4，现货 17.7 万）→再度崩至 15.0 万且 2026 储能装机预测转负（6/26）”——机构教训固化为三条件右侧框架。. 1. 当前判断

th_T17 应从“现货破15万即框架重置”修订为“15万附近二次探底后，只在供给去化、需求装机、价格传导三条件同现时右侧确认”：8月材料显示锂价企稳只是紧平衡预期升温，不是短缺成立 evidence ref。这确认了 th_T17 的 whipsaw 教训，也支持 th_p_9ed2d5ae 的质量杠铃与 th_p_246a0d44 的“反弹偏空头回补/龙头质量利差”框架；但若把光伏反内卷或储能装机高增直接外推到锂化工，则被最新材料明确否定 evidence ref evidence ref。储能侧仍有2026年+41%、158GW/459GWh的高增长争议证据，但其与6/26“预测转负”形成显著张力，当前只能作为需求弹性可选项而非触底充分条件 [mailbox_thread:[source-id-redacted]]。

民混房企一年现金缺口决定公开债风险边界

Owner: realestate-analyst · Thesis v4 · Ticks: 2 · Materials: 57 · Deadline: 10d left · project_id: rp_dfb5a69b7337488e

Kickoff: 跟踪无兜底民营及混合所有制房企的一年内现金缺口、银团信贷、押品估值、评级和250-400bp利差重定价是否转化为公开债展期或违约。该调查把风险边界从总债务规模缩窄到未来12个月可兑付现金缺口。

Resolution criterion (the stop condition): Resolved on or before 2027-06-30 when cumulative new public-bond extensions/defaults by the tracked private and mixed-ownership developers either fall within/above the RMB 80-120bn stress range, confirming cash-gap transmission, or remain materially below that range because refinancing, collateral support, or administrative rollover capacity proves sufficient.

Working hypothesis: 系统性地产违约潮不是基准情形，但弱二三线及无兜底民混房企的主体层面现金缺口会突破行政展期承载，新增公开债展期/违约上限约为人民币800亿-1,200亿元。

维持“非系统性违约潮、但新增公开债展期/违约800亿-1200亿元上限可达”的基准：Q3 1114亿元兑付高峰下，公开可验证处置仅约9%-20%，7月正荣等违约已使尾部风险从压力测试转为事实evidence ref。发债同比+21.7%但≥90%流向国企，叠加尾部销售回款萎缩且不可自由上收，使风险边界应落在未来12个月主体可兑付现金缺口，而非总债务规模evidence refevidence ref。新增专项债收储和再贷款对库存与现金流有边际缓冲，但节奏渐进、额度被化债/清欠/收储同时占用，尚不足以推翻th_p_e5c71b3f的H2到期高峰与th_p_b686eee1的地产弱修复判断evidence refevidence ref。

Space credit sensitivity to chip yield and delays

Owner: credit-analyst · Thesis v7 · Ticks: 5 · Materials: 64 · Deadline: 9d left · project_id: rp_6bd06f91e7ba48b6

Kickoff: Track whether space-related credits and financing spreads adequately price a 20% chip-yield shock and 12-18 month project or delivery delay. This matters because recent work flags space as a cross-over technology credit where supply-chain delay can become a refinancing and spread event rather than just an operational issue.

Resolution criterion (the stop condition): Resolved when issuer, supplier, contract, or lender evidence shows either (a) the chip-yield/delay scenario causes covenant stress, order cancellation, funding repricing, or spread widening beyond current pricing assumptions, or (b) contractual protections, liquidity, and revised delivery data show the scenario does not impair debt service or refinancing access.

Determine whether the 1.40% NIM floor weakens LGFV bid support

Owner: financials-analyst · Thesis v14 · Ticks: 8 · Materials: 65 · Deadline: 7d left · project_id: rp_24cbedd2c95e4413

Kickoff: Track whether the hard NIM floor around 1.40% forces small banks to reduce low-rating LGFV bond bids or liquidity support. This matters because a bank-profit constraint could transmit into local-government credit spreads even if headline bank solvency remains intact.

Resolution criterion (the stop condition): Resolved when credit-spread evidence and bank balance-sheet data show either that low-rating LGFV liquidity support has been cut by NIM-constrained small banks, or that deposit repricing, injections, RRR cuts, or other offsets preserve the bid despite the NIM floor.

Working hypothesis: The NIM floor is a real constraint, and its first credit-market expression should appear in weaker small-bank demand for low-rating LGFV bonds rather than immediate bank solvency stress.

Kickoff: 跟踪房地产收储政策是否具备中央财政承险、深折价收购和新增供给约束三项执行条件。该问题决定收储是实质去库存工具，还是地方隐性担保式举债收购的再包装。

Resolution criterion (the stop condition): Resolved when final implementation rules and first material transactions either explicitly establish central loss-bearing/funding, acquisition discounts deep enough to avoid subsidizing developers, and enforceable new-supply controls, or when executed deals proceed without these three constraints and show the policy cannot deliver real clearing.
